title: Metropolis-Scale Resilient and Trustworthy Traffic Flow Inference Using Multi-Source Data
abstract: arXiv:2605.25004v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inferring network-wide traffic states from sparse observations with high accuracy and trustworthy uncertainty quantification is essential for intelligent transportation systems, yet it remains challenging due to the underdetermined nature of the problem, multifaceted disturbances in sensing networks, and the inherent conflicts among multiple inference subtasks when modeled jointly. We propose the Task-Aware Attentive Neural Process (TA-ANP), a unified probabilistic framework for resilient and trustworthy global traffic state inference (GTSI) by fusing floating car data (FCD) with sparse fixed-detector measurements. By casting GTSI as a stochastic process, TA-ANP leverages the meta-learning properties of neural processes to adapt rapidly to changes in sensing configurations without retraining. A task-aware multi-query attention module with distinct spatiotemporal inductive biases is introduced to handle three GTSI subtasks jointly ---

translated_title: 基于多源数据的大都市尺度弹性且可信的交通流推断
translated_abstract: 从稀疏观测中以高精度和可信的不确定性量化来推断全网交通状态，对智能交通系统至关重要，然而由于问题的欠定本质、传感网络中的多方面干扰，以及多个推断子任务在联合建模时存在的内在冲突，这一任务仍然充满挑战。我们提出了任务感知注意力神经过程（TA-ANP），这是一个统一的概率框架，通过融合浮动车数据（FCD）与稀疏固定检测器测量，实现弹性且可信的全局交通状态推断（GTSI）。通过将GTSI建模为随机过程，TA-ANP利用神经过程的元学习特性，无需重新训练即可快速适应传感配置的变化。此外，还引入了具有独特时空归纳偏置的任务感知多查询注意力模块，以联合处理三个GTSI子任务——
tldr: 提出任务感知注意力神经过程（TA-ANP）统一概率框架，融合浮动车数据与稀疏固定检测器测量，实现无需重训练即可适应传感配置变化的大都市尺度弹性可信全网交通状态推断。
en_tdlr: Proposes TA-ANP, a unified probabilistic neural process framework that fuses floating car data with sparse fixed-detector measurements to achieve resilient and trustworthy metropolis-scale traffic state inference, rapidly adapting to sensing configuration changes without retraining.
